For the second call, `beginIndex = lastIdx + separateStr.length()`; since `lastIdx` is the starting index of the last occurrence of `separateStr`, the sum is at most `nodeString.length()` (equal if the occurrence is at the end, less otherwise), thus it is never negative or greater than the length. Therefore, both calls avoid the `IndexOutOfBoundsException` throwing conditions entirely.
